description: NaKSi₂O₅ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.64-2.84 Å. In the second K site, K is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.66-3.23 Å. In the third K site, K is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.68-2.99 Å. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.44 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.77 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.56 Å. There are six inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There is one shorter (1.59 Å) and three longer (1.66 Å) Si-O bond lengths. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.59-1.67 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.59-1.68 Å. In the fourth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with two NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.58-1.67 Å. In the fifth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.67 Å. In the sixth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.59-1.67 Å. There are fifteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one K and two Si atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one K and two Si atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, and two Si atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one K, two Na, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two Si atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one K and two Si atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one K, two Na, and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Si atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two K and two Si atoms. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two K, two equivalent Na, and one Si atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one K, two Na, and one Si atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, two equivalent Na, and one Si atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two K, two Na, and one Si atom. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one K and two Si atoms.
